request.query: Triangle inequality coefficient of polynomial specialization sum over total degree fiber bounded by coefficient absolute sum

items.name: Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_9} [inst : AddCommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] (f : ι → G)
  (s : Finset ι), |∑ i ∈ s, f i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, |f i|

items.name: nat_abs_sum_le
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℤ), (∑ i ∈ s, f i).natAbs ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natAbs

items.name: AbsoluteValue.sum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] [inst_2 : PartialOrder S]
  [IsOrderedRing S] (abv : AbsoluteValue R S) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R), abv (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, abv (f i)

items.name: Polynomial.norm_coeff_le_choose_mul_mahlerMeasure
items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Polynomial ℂ), ‖p.coeff n‖ ≤ ↑(p.natDegree.choose n) * p.mahlerMeasure
